title: 2011 AMC 10A Problem 7
statement: Which of the following equations does not have a solution?

solutions.text:
A simplifies to \[ x + 7 = 0 \]\[ x = -7, \] so it has a solution.

B simplifies to \[ |-3x| = -5, \] which has no solution since absolute value makes everything positive.

Let us make sure that all the other choices have solutions.

C simplifies to \[ \sqrt{-x} = 2 \]\[ -x = 4 \]\[ x = -4, \] which is fine.

D simplifies to \[ \sqrt{x} = 8 \]\[ x = 64, \] which works.

Finally, E simplifies to \[ |-3x| = 4 \]\[ -3x = \pm 4 \] \[ x = \pm \dfrac{4}{3}, \] which has a solution as well.

Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: Check which equation asks a nonnegative expression to be negative
An absolute value plus \(5\) cannot equal \(0\)
